format_note: PROPOSED nonproduction lifecycle contract, 0710/05.04. Successor of design05.03 lifecycle.template.json (preserved). Not an authority source: each stage cites the law that owns it. Fixture approvals and rollback decisions are SYNTHETIC.

identities.approved: the signed bytes the Director's approval names
identities.before: the old seat's raw bytes before seating (rollback target)
identities.content: bytes with the mutable stamp lines removed; equal across every mechanical transition

mechanical_transitions.rule: only these lines change between staged, signed, approved, seated and retired; content must be equal. Whether version or who also change at seating is NOT assumed and needs approval before a real tool

raw_images: every identity above is kept as raw bytes keyed by sha256 before the step that replaces it; restore always writes a retained image, never a reconstructed stamp

stages.owner: model or Prime under a job; compute writes
model requests; compute checks and stamps

seat_plan: J1 records {seat_file, warehouse_file, draft_file, before, approved, retired, seated} and stores each as a raw image before any move

seat_steps.does: write the plan and raw images
rename the seat into the warehouse
write the retired image over the moved file (partial file, then replace)
rename the draft to the seat name
write the seated image (partial file, then replace)

seat_states.basis: (seat_file, warehouse_file, draft_file) observed sha256, compared with the plan
seat_states.partial_files: a `.partial` file is accepted only if its bytes equal the planned image for the state it completes
seat_states.any_other: held: restart-state-unknown, or completed-drift when J7 is recorded; no write

preflight_before_first_write: raw images for before and approved present and intact

rollback_steps.does: record the decision and ledger line `rollback-planned`
rename the seated face to its draft name
rename the retired face back to the seat name
ledger line `rolled-back`; the seated bytes stay as a raw image

warehouse.law_status: 0009 is silent on layout; proposal only

supported_interruptions: a stop after any seat step J1-J6 or rollback step R1-R5, including inside J4 and J6 between the partial write and the replace, in this fixture's single-process model
not_supported: power loss inside a rename or replace (an OS guarantee, not shown here)
two seating processes at once (no lock modelled)
a release of more than two faces
changes to stamp lines other than Authorization and state
not_in_this_template: any copy in place of a rename
